item.title: Daisy Chain ~Terminator Girl~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kisu
  • 発売日: 2005-02-25
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: でいじーちぇーん 〜TERMINATOR GIRL〜
  • 英語名: Daisy Chain Terminator Girl

あらすじ

Class idol and rich girl Reiko finds an interest in an average boy Mamoru. When he tries to confess to Reiko, the whole place gets drawn in a flash where girl Ibrize stands. She is an android who comes from future to change Mamoru’s fate. She is constructed in such a way that at any time and place she can can take off her clothes and coerce Mamoru to sex. At the same time another girl calling herself Mamoru’s daughter Mana arrives from future to prevent the change in history. The situation is aggravated by the attacks of “Lilith” type androids. Which side will protagonist take?

item.title: Shiroi Hebi no Yoru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kisu
  • 発売日: 2003-04-25
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 白い蛇の夜
  • 英語名: Shiroi Hebi no Yoru

あらすじ

Main character is an ordinary student, but with pervert nature. He finally decides to confess to a girl, but she is attacked by some evil spirit. Protagonist jumps ahead of her and dies. But his soul can not come up with the fact that he’s going to die a virgin, so the soul rushes back to fight for control of the body. As a result, protagonist controls his body only during daytime. At night evil spirit dominates with the aim to hurt the dearest persons to main character.
